messages:
Jordan S.: KPMG just emailed asking for KMS/keystore access logs + chain-of-custody for the auth incident on 2025-11-03 that produced latency spikes and a billing anomaly. They want exports, a hash manifest, and repro steps. Can we package within 48h? cc @Priya R.
Priya R.: we can. Do we have exact time window from their message?
KPMG Auditor: KPMG: please provide 2025-11-03 02:30:00 -> 2025-11-03 04:30:00 UTC. Need records for key ops (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext) and IAM principals. CSV or JSONL ok. Also need chain-of-custody + SHA256 manifest.
Maya L.: Got it. I'll create a repro checklist and sanitized request traces. We'll include: raw KMS audit (JSONL), API gateway traces (masked), key-access CSV, manifest.sha256, and timeline.md. Where should we upload?
Jordan S.: Use s3://redwood-audits/kpmg/soc2/2025-11-03/ with restricted ACL. Provide presigned links (7d) and a signed manifest (coc-signer). Tag with retention=90d and label 'soc2:audit'.
Priya R.: starting export job now. CloudKMS + CloudHSM bundling might take ~2-3 hrs for that window. Creating job exp-20251103-0421. I'll include an access_control.csv listing principal, key_arn, action, timestamp.
AuditBot: Export job created: id=exp-20251103-0421, type=kms-audit, window=2025-11-03T02:30:00Z/2025-11-03T04:30:00Z, created_by=Priya R.
Maya L.: Repro snippet (sanitized) for the auth failure path:
```
# reproduce high QPS auth path (tokens redacted)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/infer -d '{"model":"gpt-3.5x","input":"<test>"}' -v --trace-ascii /tmp/trace.txt
# capture gateway headers and KMS calls in /tmp/trace.txt
```
Maya L.: sample log lines we'll include (sanitized):
2025-11-03T03:12:08Z KMS AccessDenied key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 principal=svc-api-prod reason=quota-exceeded
2025-11-03T03:12:09Z API-GW  200 svc-api-prod request_id=req-0a1b2c latency_ms=4800
2025-11-03T03:13:41Z KMS GenerateDataKey key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 principal=svc-batcher
Priya R.: export finished (partial stream). Uploading to s3://redwood-audits/kpmg/soc2/2025-11-03/exp-20251103-0421.tar.gz -> presigned: https://s3.redwood.example/exp-20251103-0421.tar.gz?XSRF=... (expires in 7d). Added manifest.csv + manifest.sha256 + timeline.md.
Jordan S.: Confirm there were no key rotations in that window? We need that explicitly in the chain-of-custody.
Priya R.: Confirmed: rotation pipeline shows no rotations for keys matching alias redwood-prod-* between 2025-10-28 and 2025-11-10. I added rotations:none to manifest.csv and signed manifest with coc-signer key=signer-01.
KPMG Auditor: KPMG: we received the link. We will validate timestamps, presence of Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events, and verify SHA256 hashes. We accept sanitized traces (tokens redacted) but need unambiguous principal ARNs and key ARNs. Also confirm whether the exported logs include the KMS response_code field.
Maya L.: logs include response_code and request_id fields. I can regenerate a tiny sample JSONL for verification if they want.
KPMG Auditor: Please include a 10-line sample JSONL (full fields) so we can confirm format before pulling full export.
Priya R.: attaching sample snippet to S3 (sample-10.jsonl) and updated manifest. Shared new presigned link: https://s3.redwood.example/sample-10.jsonl?XSRF=...
KPMG Auditor: KPMG: sample looks good. We'll proceed to review full bundle and reply within 48h. Thanks. :thumbsup:
Jordan S.: Thanks team — keep thread updated if any access issues or if auditor requests expanded window.
Priya R.: note for ops: retention for exported bundle will be 90d and then auto-delete unless legal extends. I added ticket INFRA-5923 to track.
Maya L.: closing loop: repro checklist and sanitized traces are in the bundle. If auditor needs live repro, we'll schedule a session in a dedicated sandbox (no production keys).
